'''Assistant Barrister General''' was a position within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The Assistant Barrister General was the highest desk-bound position [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] position within the entire Republic. During the last years of the Republic's rule, [[Sayer Mon Neela]] held the position.<ref name="J10">{{JournalCite|10|The Capture of Imperial Hazard|The Capture of ''Imperial Hazard''}}</ref>
